papers.title: The effect of manufacturing method induced roughness on severe service control valve performance
papers.abstract: There are a number of manufacturing methods used for the manufacture of control valve trim components, some of which are expensive processes. Current market conditions and increased competition requires manufacturers to reduce costs of these components and they are investigating new technologies such as processes using Additive Layer Manufacturing (ALM) to produce these components. These processes may require or result in variations in geometrical features and surface roughness of the produced components compared to current processes, this study quantifies the effects of the selective laser melting (SLM); a form of ALM, methods induced features on the overall valve performance of the control valve via experimental measurements of valve capacity (Cv) and the roughness of the manufactured parts.
papers.venue: University of Huddersfield Repository (University of Huddersfield)

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究工业阀门制造中表面粗糙度对性能的影响，与生物医学植入物或应力遮挡无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on industrial control valve performance (Cv) and does not address biomedical implants, stress shielding, osseointegration, or mechanical testing of porous structures for orthopedic applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究不同制造工艺（含增材制造）引起的表面粗糙度对控制阀性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 通过SLM和传统工艺制造控制阀组件，实验测量阀容量和粗糙度
summary_zh.result: 表面粗糙度变化影响阀容量，量化了SLM诱导特征对性能的作用
summary_zh.validation: 实验测量阀容量和表面粗糙度进行对比验证

summary_en.motivation: Investigate how manufacturing method-induced surface roughness affects the performance of control valves in severe service conditions.
summary_en.method: Control valve trim components were fabricated using selective laser melting (SLM) and traditional methods, and valve capacity (Cv) and surface roughness were experimentally measured.
summary_en.result: Variations in surface roughness significantly influenced valve capacity, quantifying the effect of SLM-induced features on control valve performance.
summary_en.validation: Experimental measurements of valve capacity and surface roughness were used to compare the performance of components made by different manufacturing methods.

papers.title: Fluoroscopy improves femoral stem placement in cementless total hip arthroplasty
papers.abstract: Fluoroscopy is routinely used in trauma cases to evaluate alignment and reduction quality. Because conventional templating has a high mismatch rate, we sought to explore whether we could use intraoperative fluoroscopy while implanting the femoral stem. Sixty patients with Croft 3-4 coxarthrosis were included in this study. No preoperative templating was performed in either of the two groups. The final conformations of the stem sizes and positions were achieved freehand intraoperatively using anatomic landmarks. In the second group, after surgeons intraoperatively agreed on the final stem size, C-arm fluoroscopy images are obtained with the last rasp size before the stem implantation. The alignment of femoral stem according to the femoral canal, the lower leg discrepancy (LLD) and the lateral offsets were evaluated with X ray. The stem/endosteal areas at 2 cm above the trochanter minor (T+2) and 2 cm below the trochanter minor (T-2) and the deviation of the stem tip from the center of the femoral canal were evaluated in CT images. The stems that were implanted under fluoroscopic control filled the medullary cavity better at both the T+2 and T-2 levels. On fluoroscopy, in the control group, the malpositioning of the femoral stems were less, the centralizations were better, and the restorations of the lateral offset and LLD were more accurate. The use of fluoroscopy while rasping the femoral canal leads to proper alignment and press fitting of the stem and provides the opportunity to intraoperatively correct malpositionings of the stem. [Med-Science 2017; 6(2.000): 264-9]

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅关注临床手术中荧光透视对股骨柄植入位置的影响，未涉及任何生物力学建模或应力分析。
llm.why_not_core: No FEA, no stress shielding or micromotion quantification, no intact vs implanted femur comparison, no patient-specific modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估术中荧光透视对股骨柄植入位置准确性的影响
summary_zh.method: 对比两组患者，一组使用荧光透视辅助植入股骨柄，另一组不使用
summary_zh.result: 荧光透视组股骨柄填充髓腔更好，偏移更小，外侧偏距和肢体长度恢复更准确
summary_zh.validation: 通过术后X线和CT影像评估股骨柄位置和匹配度

summary_en.motivation: To assess whether intraoperative fluoroscopy improves femoral stem alignment and press-fit in cementless THA.
summary_en.method: Sixty patients were divided into two groups; the fluoroscopy group had C-arm images taken after rasping but before stem implantation to verify alignment.
summary_en.result: Stems placed with fluoroscopic control showed better medullary filling at two levels, fewer malpositions, and more accurate restoration of lateral offset and leg length.
summary_en.validation: Postoperative X-rays and CT scans were used to evaluate stem position, alignment, and canal filling.
